text: {"question": "How is telemonitoring evolving beyond simple blood pressure surveillance within the framework of digital hypertension?", "answer": "Telemonitoring is evolving in three major domains: integrating multidimensional health information (like physical activity and sleep) with longitudinal BP measurements, utilizing physician-support technologies (such as AI analytics and clinical decision-support) to interpret data and aid clinical interventions, and employing patient-support technologies (like digital therapeutics) for continuous behavioral interventions and self-management support.", "evidence": "Within the framework of digital hypertension, telemonitoring is evolving beyond simple BP surveillance in three major domains. First, advances in data monitoring enable the integration of multidimensional health information, including physical activity, sleep patterns, medication adherence, and environmental exposures, with longitudinal BP measurements. Second, physician-support technologies, such as automated data integration, clinical decision-support systems, and artificial intelligence-based analytics, facilitate the interpretation of large-scale patient-generated data and support timely clinical intervention. Third, patient-support technologies, including digital therapeutics, provide continuous behavioral interventions and self-management support"}
